name: Delta Sigma Pi - Sigma Upsilon Chapter
description: Delta Sigma Pi is a professional co-ed business fraternity. The Sigma Upsilon Chapter at the University of Washington was founded in 2012 and installed as a chapter in May 2013.

membersPortal.label: RateMyBrofessor
membersPortal.note: Members only. Sign in with an approved UW email.

landAcknowledgment: We, the Sigma Upsilon chapter of Delta Sigma Pi, acknowledge that we are on the traditional land of the first people of Seattle - the Coast Salish peoples, which encompasses the Duwamish, Suquamish, Tulalip, and Muckleshoot nations - past and present with honor and gratitude for the land itself and the respective tribes.

contactPage.heading: Contact Us
contactPage.text: To learn more about our chapter, brothers, and recruitment, follow us on Instagram and LinkedIn or send us an email!
